name: prooftrail
description: Prooftrail — checks your AI coding agent against the rules you set, at the end of every turn. Set your rules once on your account (tests ran, they passed, the run happened after the last edit, and more) and every session decides the mechanical ones on your own machine, with no extra model call. You choose, per rule, whether a finding blocks the turn, tells the agent, or only tells you. Rules live on the server, so the agent being checked cannot edit its own gate. Optional hosted judge for the rules that need judgment.

SERVICE_URL.title: Review service URL
SERVICE_URL.description: Origin of the review API. Defaults to the hosted service; override for self-hosted deployments.

LOCAL_AGENT.title: Local agent for deep claim checks (optional)
LOCAL_AGENT.description: Which local CLI may run deep claim checks: `auto` for whichever of codex or agy is installed, or name one. THIS IS ONE OF TWO GATES and both must be open. This one chooses the tool; the other is the `deep-check` setting in your Prooftrail rules (off / inform / await), which lives on the server so an agent cannot switch off its own verifier. Set this and leave `deep-check` off and nothing runs — that is not a bug. Deep checks run read-only on YOUR model credentials; nothing leaves your machine.

API_TOKEN.title: Device token
API_TOKEN.description: Paired device token. Leave blank on the host (run /prooftrail:setup instead); set this only for sandbox surfaces, whose plugin data is wiped per session.
